RUSH: Race the opposing heroes and ignore the board: every card goes into hero damage, accepting whatever their board does to you in the meantime.
CONTROL: Clear the opposing board methodically and play the long game: sweepers, removal and card advantage first, hero damage later.
BALANCE: Answer only what would actually kill you this turn cycle and put everything else into hero damage.
SETUP: Hold resources and build your own engine or win condition (levels, attachments, key equipment) before committing to a fight.
DISRUPT: Attack the opponent's engine or key piece directly: hand, gold, Abilities, Areas, equipment or the one card their plan needs.
